requirement_text: The user shall be able to create a todo item with non-empty text.
The system shall reject creating a todo item when the todo text is empty.
The system shall limit todo text length to 100 characters.
The user shall be able to mark an active todo item as completed.
The user shall be able to mark a completed todo item as active again.
The user shall be able to delete an existing todo item.
The system shall display all todo items in the todo list.
The system shall keep todo items after page refresh.
